translationRepairs: 列傳第五十四 is a section number.
Early in the Datong era he was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
Early in the Datong era he was promoted to Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.
右丞 here is 尚書右丞.
When Left Household Gentleman Shen Jiong and Junior Chamberlain Gu Yu once failed to win approval on a report, the emperor scolded them harshly to their faces.
When Left Household Gentleman Shen Jiong and Assistant of the Lesser Treasury Gu Yu once failed to win approval on a report, the emperor scolded them harshly to their faces.
少府丞 is assistant of the Lesser Treasury.
Emperor Yuan also ordered Protector of the Army Yin Yue, Pacifier of the East Du You'an, Inspector of Ba Prefecture Wang Xun, and others to join him, all under Wencheng's command.
Emperor Yuan also ordered General Protector of the Army Yin Yue, General Pacifying the East Du You'an, Inspector of Ba Prefecture Wang Xun, and others to join him, all under Wencheng's command.
護軍將軍 and 平東將軍 are general titles.
Under Chen, in the Tiankang era, he became Central Recorder Aide to the Prince of Shixing.
Under Chen, in the Tianjia era, he became Central Recorder Aide to the Prince of Shixing.
He rose to Administrator of Jinling and Supernumerary Attendant Cavalry Regular, and soon died.
He rose to Administrator of Jinling (晉陵) and Supernumerary Attendant Cavalry Regular, and soon died.
Distinguish 晉陵 from 金陵.

Early in Datong Wei forces again besieged Nanzheng. Huaibao sent his third son Niao with two hundred men against the Wei vanguard at Guangdao Temple. A stray arrow struck Niao's eye and he lost his horse as enemy spears closed in. He cut down a rider, mounted, and galloped back.

Early in Datong Wei forces again besieged Nanzheng. Huaibao sent his third son Yi with two hundred men against the Wei vanguard at Guangdao Temple. A stray arrow struck Yi's eye and he lost his horse as enemy spears closed in. He cut down a rider, mounted, and galloped back.
嶷 is read Yi. 嶷 is read Yi.
Niao's strength was unmatched. He was a superb horseman and archer and fought seven or eight battles in a single day.
Yi's strength was unmatched. He was a superb horseman and archer and fought seven or eight battles in a single day.
Niao became Inspector of Western Jing Prefecture. A prophecy then ran: "Beneath the character for 'alone' in Liang stands a blind Son of Heaven." Emperor Yuan believed Niao was meant.
Yi became Inspector of Western Jing Prefecture. A prophecy then ran: "Beneath the character for 'alone' in Liang stands a blind Son of Heaven." Emperor Yuan believed Yi was meant.
嶷 is read Yi. 嶷 is read Yi.
When Niao reburied his father and grandfather, the emperor ordered the tomb painters to portray the site unfavorably. Within a year Niao was dead.
When Yi reburied his father and grandfather, the emperor ordered the tomb painters to portray the site unfavorably. Within a year Yi was dead.
嶷 is read Yi. 嶷 is read Yi.
Qi had nine brothers: Song, Cen, Niao, Ji, Yan, and An were his elders; Song and You'an were his younger brothers. All were well known.
Qi had nine brothers: Song, Cen, Yi, Ji, Yan, and An were his elders; Song and You'an were his younger brothers. All were well known.

Hou Jing then sent cavalry by a hidden route and seized Ying Prefecture, capturing Inspector Fang Zhu. Panic spread. Wencheng fled up the Han, the armies broke, and You'an surrendered to Hou Jing, who killed him for his repeated betrayals.

Hou Jing then sent cavalry by a hidden route and seized Ying Prefecture, capturing Inspector Fangzhu. Panic spread. Wencheng fled up the Han, the armies broke, and You'an surrendered to Hou Jing, who killed him for his repeated betrayals.
方諸 is a single given name.
He rose to Interior Minister of Yueyang and, for military merit, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ning.
He rose to Interior Minister of Yueyang and, for military merit, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jianning.
The Prince of Changsha Fan Xiao and the upstream generals made Lin leader of the alliance.
Xiao Shao, the feudal prince at Changsha, and the upstream generals made Lin leader of the alliance.
蕃王蕭韶 is the prince Xiao Shao.
Lin's general Zhang Ping owned a warship that before victory would sound like a wild boar. Lin's fleet numbered in the thousands and was named the Wild Boars.
Lin's general Zhang Pingzhai owned a warship that before victory would sound like a wild boar. Lin's fleet numbered in the thousands and was named the Wild Boars.
The southern river chieftains Xiong Tanlang and Zhou Di wavered. Lin sent Li Xiaoqin, Fan Meng, and Yu Xiaoling against them.
The southern river chieftains Xiong Tanlang and Zhou Di wavered. Lin sent Li Xiaoqin, Fan Meng, and Yu Xiaoqing against them.

Emperor Wenxuan of Qi sent troops to escort Zhuang and dispatched Acting Director of the Secretariat Li Taozhu to invest Lin as Liang Chancellor, Commander of all armies, and Recorder of the Ministry of State Affairs.

Emperor Wenxuan of Qi sent troops to escort Zhuang and dispatched Acting Director of the Secretariat Li Taotu to invest Lin as Liang Chancellor, Commander of all armies, and Recorder of the Ministry of State Affairs.
He was further advanced to Duke of Baling.
He was further advanced to Prince of Baling Commandery.
巴陵郡王 is a princely title.
Zhang Biao, once he met He Huai, did not stop until death;
Zhang Biao, once he met with favor, held to it until death;
何懷 is not a name; 一遇何懷 means having once met favor, what he cherished.
